requirements.text: Students should be able to find resources quickly and manage loans online.
The system should allow students to see their checked-out items and due dates.
Students should receive reminders about due dates.
Librarians need tools to manage inventory and handle exceptions like holds or account restrictions.
Room booking should be easy for students, allowing them to find and select available rooms.
There should be oversight for handling potential issues with room bookings.
The system must manage loans and any associated fines effectively.
There must be a balance between automation and manual control in the system.
